title: AI公司不在意利息：优质债券年化6%，长期还选权益吗？
speaker: Adrian Zuercher

segments.en: Do you think that when it comes to higher financing costs, is that going to be still some sort of overhang when it comes to the AI trade?
segments.zh: 您认为融资成本上升是否仍会对AI交易构成某种压力？

segments.en: Well, at the moment, these companies, they just don't care if they issue at 50 base points more.
segments.zh: 目前这些公司根本不在意多发50个基点。

segments.en: And we started a little bit of a crowding out also for government bonds.
segments.zh: 这也开始对政府债券产生一定的挤出效应。

segments.en: And so it had an impact on overrun spreads.
segments.zh: 因此对超额利差产生了影响。

segments.en: And it had an impact overrun rates. Now, as a multi-asset class investor, after, say, rates and bonds really start to look attractive,
segments.zh: 也对超额利率产生了影响。现在，作为多资产类别市场参与者，当利率和债券开始真正显得有吸引力时，

segments.en: you get probably 6% per annum yield on a good quality bond portfolio.
segments.zh: 一个优质债券组合的年化收益率可能达到6%。

segments.en: And it's just simple math. If you invest at the yield of six in five years in average, usually you will probably clock in at least 6% return per annum.
segments.zh: 这是简单的数学。如果以6%的收益率**五年，平均而言，通常每年至少能获得6%的回报。

segments.en: And that's quite attractive for the risk level you take.
segments.zh: 考虑到所承担的风险水平，这相当有吸引力。

segments.en: Short term, of course, we still think equities have a bit more upside.
segments.zh: 当然，短期来看，我们仍认为权益资产还有一定上行空间。

segments.en: But if you look on a 10-year basis, we just did our research there.
segments.zh: 但如果以10年为基准来看，我们刚刚做了相关研究。
债券表现实际上优于权益资产。

segments.en: Once you have sort of a equities risk premium at zero, once you have yielded around six at six and a half on a good investment grade portfolio.
segments.zh: 一旦权益风险溢价归零，优质**级组合收益率达到6%至6.5%左右。

segments.en: So the long-term case for equities or bonds has been a bit more compromised.
segments.zh: 因此，权益资产或债券的长期逻辑受到一定影响。

segments.en: But short term, I think both have a nice upside now.
segments.zh: 但短期来看，我认为两者都有不错的上行空间。

segments.en: How constructive are you in Chinese tech?
segments.zh: 你对中国科技板块有多乐观？
